mismatch.message: js/dokick.js ports ship_object() and migration setup, but js/do.js:obj_delivery() only records note_unported('dokick.c obj_delivery') when migrating objects exist. During the first next-level generation, js/makemon_create.js:makemon() also fails closed on any migrating_objs list before C's supported level generation can finish.

evidence: The original diagnostic baseline recorded 263/336 screens, 3899/5115 RNG calls, and 263/336 cursors at the first stop in segment 0, step 263. Its recording SHA is unchanged.

The accepted 92dd v64 baseline retains the same manifest case recording SHA c44a8ac5aa0ea15b4677d5ee373a5e5fdc261b781741ff62b3bbf8a21d50ccbf and the same 263/336 screens, 3899/5115 RNG calls, 263/336 cursors, null error, and step-263 migrating-object-delivery stop. The manifest/evaluation identity changed; the earlier diagnostic provenance is retained separately.

The recipe sends three apples down the actual downstairs. The selected mismatch occurs in do.c:goto_level() during level transition; dokick.c:obj_delivery() is called before timers and again after arrival messages. makemon.c:makemon() removes no result from deliver_obj_to_mon(); that remaining void callee is recorded with note_unported().

source.branch: obj_delivery() delivers migrating objects whose destination is the level being entered; do.c:goto_level() calls it before away-time timers and after arrival messages.
callers: do.c:goto_level() calls dokick.c:obj_delivery(FALSE) before run_timers() and obj_delivery(TRUE) after the room-entry message.
do.c:dodown() reaches goto_level() for the recorded downstairs input; JavaScript js/do.js:goto_level() now awaits the imported js/dokick.js:obj_delivery() at both source sites.
makemon.c:makemon() calls dokick.c:deliver_obj_to_mon() after inventory and strategy setup when allow_minvent and gm.migrating_objs are true; this discarded-result callee remains an explicit gap.
dependencies: dokick.c:deliver_obj_to_mon() is not ported in this bounded task; makemon.c discards its result and JavaScript records note_unported() at the matching call site.

summary: The downstairs transition stops because dokick.c:obj_delivery() is still a JavaScript gap and makemon.c:makemon() has a blanket refusal for migrating objects. Port the full delivery function and remove that unsupported refusal, preserving the discarded deliver_obj_to_mon() gap according to C call semantics.
